brief.claim: Over a ten-year record, monthly hospital admissions rose after accounting for catchment population: in a linear regression of monthly admissions on time and catchment population, the coefficient of time is positive and significant at the one-sided 5% level (t test).

data_keys.meaning: Number of hospital admissions in each month.
Catchment population in each month, in thousands.
Time of each month in years since the start of the record.

brief.sizes: months = 120; admissions, population and time_years each have shape (120,).
